effect.name: Adjust
effect.description: Brightness, contrast, saturation and gamma in one pass. Reach for this before stacking three effects on an object, since each extra effect is another draw.
effect.author: CyberMushroom

parameter.name: Brightness
parameter.description: Added to every channel. 0 is no change.

parameter.name: Contrast
parameter.description: Pushes colours away from mid grey. 1 is no change, 0 flattens to grey.

parameter.name: Saturation
parameter.description: 1 is no change, 0 is greyscale, above 1 oversaturates.

parameter.name: Gamma
parameter.description: Lifts or crushes the midtones without clipping the ends. 1 is no change.
